title: Spectra — Fourier Lab
description: An eleven-mode interactive Fourier & DSP lab on a from-scratch FFT. Draw shapes redrawn by rotating vectors, build and HEAR spectra, filter noise in the frequency domain, read spectrograms, and analyse LIVE MICROPHONE audio in real time (scrolling spectrogram + a pitch tuner that names the note). DESIGN digital filters on an interactive z-plane — drag poles and zeros by hand and watch magnitude, phase, group delay, impulse response and sound recompute live from a from-scratch bilinear transform (Butterworth, Chebyshev, FIR, biquad). Plus a Morlet wavelet vs STFT, a real 2-D image FFT, a phase-vocoder time-stretch/pitch-shift, a JPEG-lite DCT codec, and cepstral pitch detection. Deep-linkable; no math libraries.
